Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray shows a soft tissue opacity at the right lung apex (indicated by the arrow) with associated destruction/erosion of the adjacent first rib. In an elderly patient with a long-term smoking history, this apical mass with bone invasion is characteristic of a Pancoast tumour (superior sulcus tumour).
